name: Bubble Talk
summary: A party caption game where players match funny captions to a picture card and a rotating judge picks the winner.
rules_text: Shuffle the picture deck and the caption deck separately. Choose a starting judge and deal 7 caption cards face down to each player; keep them secret. Each round the judge reveals the top picture card. All other players choose one caption card from hand that they think is funniest with the picture and place it face down. The judge shuffles the submitted captions, flips and reads each aloud, then subjectively chooses the funniest. The owner of the chosen caption keeps the picture card as a point. Discard all submitted captions. Players keep unplayed captions. Pass judging left, each player draws back to 7 captions, reshuffling discards if needed. First player to collect 5 picture cards wins.
rating_reason: Judge with picture and caption cards, hidden hands, caption selection game.
